novel_features.name: Batch model fanout
novel_features.description: Submit one prompt to N models in parallel and track them as a single fanout group.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local SQLite to link request_ids under a fanout_id; the official CLI and both MCPs are single-job primitives.
novel_features.example: higgsfield-pp-cli fanout --prompt "cinematic dawn over Manhattan, slow camera push" --models veo3_1,seedance_2_0,kling3_0 --max-cost 200 --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this whenever you need to compare the same prompt across models; one command replaces N submits and N polls.

novel_features.name: Fanout wait + compare
novel_features.description: Poll every job in a fanout, then render a side-by-side table of model, cost, duration, and result URL.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local generations table joined on fanout_id; no upstream tool persists grouped runs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Decide which model to ship by reading one table, not N tabs.

novel_features.name: Soul library search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across Soul ID names plus the prompts each Soul ID has been used in, ranked by last-used.
novel_features.rationale: FTS5 index over the local soul_ids and generations tables; the official soul-id list is unindexed and exposes only the raw API page.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Stop scrolling Soul IDs to find the one you trained two months ago; ask by name or by the prompt that used it.

novel_features.name: Credit guard for batches
novel_features.description: Pre-flight cost estimate across every fanout model; refuses to submit if total exceeds the cap and prints the per-model breakdown.
novel_features.rationale: Sums real per-model cost endpoint estimates locally before any submit lands; no upstream tool enforces a pre-flight budget.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run before you spend; the operator (or agent) sees the credit hit before the run lands.

novel_features.name: Prompt history search
novel_features.description: FTS5 search across every prompt you've ever submitted, joined with model, Soul ID name, and transaction memo.
novel_features.rationale: Built on the framework's local FTS index over synced generations; the official CLI's generate list re-paginates the API.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Recall the exact prompt that produced last week's hero shot without re-typing or guessing.

novel_features.name: Soul usage report
novel_features.description: Every generation that used a given Soul ID, ordered by date, with thumbnail URLs and total cost.
novel_features.rationale: Local SQL join over soul_ids and generations; impossible without persisting both tables locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Audit a Soul ID's history before retiring it, or pull every cut-in for an episode summary.

novel_features.name: Account spend report
novel_features.description: Local SQL aggregation over synced credit transactions, grouped by model, day, or Soul ID.
novel_features.rationale: Joins transactions × generations × models on request_id; the official account transactions returns flat events.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Weekly credit review without manual pagination; forecasts next month's spend by trend.

novel_features.name: Generations export
novel_features.description: Export the local generations table joined with models and Soul IDs to CSV or JSONL for spreadsheet review or downstream pipelines.
novel_features.rationale: Reads from the local synced store with a standard CSV/JSONL encoder; agent-friendly pipeline output.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Hand the week's output to any tool that reads CSV/JSONL; no manual scraping required.

narrative.headline: Every Higgsfield workflow with a local memory: batch model fanouts, Soul library search, and credit guards no other Higgsfield tool has.
narrative.value_prop: This CLI mirrors the official Higgsfield CLI surface (auth, generate, soul-id, marketing-studio, product-photoshoot, marketplace-cards, upload, account, workspace) and adds the local SQLite store that powers fanout, soul-ids search, credit guards, and prompt history search. Single binary, agent-native JSON-first, MCP-exposed via the runtime Cobra-tree mirror.
narrative.auth_narrative: Two auth paths. Web backend (default, recommended for most 2026 models): set HIGGSFIELD_JWT from your logged-in Higgsfield CLI's credentials file and HIGGSFIELD_ENABLE_WEB_BACKEND=1. Platform API (stable, ~8 models): set HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY and HIGGSFIELD_SECRET (or HF_CREDENTIALS=KEY:SECRET). The CLI picks the right backend per model; commands that need the unselected backend will print an actionable error.

quickstart.comment: submit one prompt to two models with a credit guard
poll all jobs in the fanout and render results side by side

troubleshoots.fix: Run `higgsfield auth login` in your terminal (the official CLI), then `higgsfield-pp-cli auth set-token "$(higgsfield auth token)"`
Export HIGGSFIELD_ENABLE_WEB_BACKEND=1 to opt into cloud.higgsfield.ai endpoints (Veo 3.x, Sora 2, Kling 3, Soul V2, Nano Banana 2, Seedance 2)

troubleshoots.symptom: model X requires platform API key
troubleshoots.fix: Set HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY and HIGGSFIELD_SECRET (or HF_CREDENTIALS=KEY:SECRET); generate a key at platform.higgsfield.ai
Raise --max-cost, drop a model from --models, or run `generate cost <model> --prompt ...` individually to inspect
The web backend __session cookie rotates every ~1 minute. Re-run `higgsfield auth login` (the official CLI handles the refresh) then re-set HIGGSFIELD_JWT

narrative.when_to_use: Use higgsfield-pp-cli whenever you need to drive Higgsfield from an agent or want local memory across runs. Pick the official `higgsfield` CLI when you only need a single human one-shot generation. Pick higgsfield-pp-cli when you want batch fanouts, Soul ID search, credit guards, persistent generation history, or MCP exposure. The CLI mirrors every command the official one offers, so switching is loss-free.
